equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The constrained predicate is a proper colouring plus a nonmonochromatic open neighborhood at every vertex; all vertices have degree three. An open-neighborhood conflict-free proper colouring demands that some neighbor colour occur exactly once, equivalent on these three-neighbor multisets to at least two distinct neighbor colours. Neither a closed-neighborhood conflict-free predicate nor a 3-dynamic (three different neighbor colours) predicate is equivalent.

value.rationale: The new contribution is the complete optimal-palette *constrained recolouring metric* for the Petersen graph, not the already known count and symmetry classes. Forbidding monochromatic open neighborhoods while recolouring changes global shortest-path geometry from the previously published unrestricted radius 13/diameter 14 to 15/16. The exact 20160 legal transitions, complete 16-distance distribution and singleton colour-class criterion constitute a natural, nontrivial finite reconfiguration classification with potential comparison to constrained-colouring mixing, beyond a textbook deduction of prior orbit counts.
